name: Ulathek the Traitor
label: Quest
description: Ulathek the Traitor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You wish to enter my good graces? Then kill for me.
My servant, Ulathek, is pathetic how he grovels before me, all the while plotting with Lord Hel'nurath on Xoroth. Hel'nurath plans to usurp my power here, and Ulathek is his spy...

Prove that you serve me and not my rivals. Confront Ulathek in his quarters, in the Shadow Hold to the west. Tell him that I know his secret and watch as fear grips him. Then, bring me the traitor's heart!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can already taste the heart of Ulathek on my lips. So sweet is the flesh of a traitor...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, how splendid! After rotting a week, this heart will prove a succulent treat! Perhaps I will send for Ulathek's head and place it before me as I eat...
You have done me a service, adventurer, and so my patience for you has grown. Marginally.
